acceptance_scope: CPU source export, built-wheel install, and a two-node GB10 launch on the maintainers' hosts
packaged_gpu_launch_note: Production on two GB10 nodes with the recorded image and profile: live typed (including wide 17..256), chat, tool, streaming and capture checks, promoted 2026-10-20; earlier acceptance included a real rollback. Not a clean install on a fresh machine; no reboot test.

engine.full_source_commit_blocker: Image build label says unknown; a complete fork/source mapping and build recipe were not recovered

upstream_runner.bundled_note: Generated by engine/build_capture_patch.py from the exact upstream runner (bytes and SHA above). Drop-in only for the tested engine build; it is not a source-independent patch and will not match a different vLLM version.

helper.wide_note: Adds the opt-in wide-label capture extension used by 17..256-option choice requests: the helper writes wide_ids and wide_logits_fp32 NPZ arrays (3072 raw bytes plus a scalar wide_* block; roughly 4 to 5 KB per record) from the same validated terminal row. Disable by leaving wide_choice out of the capture config.

default_readout.choices_small_lane_note: 2..16 options use the fixed 24-slot lettered wire layout; 17..256 options use the separate wide-label lane below. One public choice API, two internal prompt surfaces.

model.layout_note: An original shard number is intentionally replaced by ten FP8 PLE shards; follow the snapshot index, not a guessed contiguous shard list

wide_label_lane.enabled_by: wide_choice block in both the gateway config and the engine capture config
wide_label_lane.live_status: Production on the two-node GB10 deployment, accepted and promoted 2026-10-20: typed wide calls at 17, 26, 27, 32, 64, 128 and 256 options passed with per-call NPZ audits and a 257-option request refused; an 84-call UI-selection smoke passed 84/84 as a separate runtime check. Option-scaling accuracy results are in docs/benchmarks.md. The <=16 path is unchanged.
wide_label_lane.wide_note: Enabling the lane requires WIDE_CHOICE=1 and an absolute WIDE_CATALOG_PATH at generation time; the catalog file must be visible with matching bytes at the configured absolute path inside every engine worker and the gateway.
